shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
find /workspace/app /workspace/lib -type f | head -50
cat /workspace/next.config.ts; echo ---; ls /workspace/__agent_eval__
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rl "cacheComponents" . | head -30
ls 01-app && echo --- && find . -iname "*suspense*" -o -iname "*loading*" | head -20
cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs

cd /workspace && cat node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "--- exports grep ---"; grep -rn "\bio\b" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

npm start >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &
sleep 6
echo "=== first bytes of /product document ==="
curl -s --no-buffer http://localhost:3000/product > /tmp/prod.html
grep -o "Premium Widget" /tmp/prod.html | head -2
echo "=== fallback present? ==="
grep -o "Checking availability\.\.\." /tmp/prod.html | head -2
echo "=== stock streamed in? ==="
grep -oE "[0-9]+ in stock" /tmp/prod.html | head -2
cd /tmp && grep -c "stock" prod.html; echo "--- occurrences ---"; grep -o "stock[^\"]\{0,20\}" prod.html | head -5; echo "--- size ---"; wc -c prod.html

find .next -path "*product*" -name "*.html" | head; echo "=== prerendered shell content ==="; for f in $(find .next -path "*product*" -name "*.html"); do echo "--- $f"; grep -o "Premium Widget" "$f" | head -1; grep -o "Checking availability\.\.\." "$f" | head -1; grep -o "in stock" "$f" | head -1; done

echo "=== prefetch payload for /product ===" && curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/pf.txt -w "http=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download} time=%{time_total}s\n" && echo "title in prefetch?" && grep -c "Premium Widget" /tmp/pf.txt && echo "fallback in prefetch?" && grep -c "Checking availability" /tmp/pf.txt && echo "inventory leaked into prefetch?" && grep -c "in stock" /tmp/pf.txt
curl -s -D- -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3000/product -o /dev/null | head -20

curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/pf.txt -w "bytes=%{size_download}\n"; echo "title in prefetch: $(grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "fallback in prefetch: $(grep -c 'Checking availability' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "inventory in prefetch: $(grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/pf.txt)"

cd /workspace; LOC=$(curl -s -D- -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" http://localhost:3000/product -o /dev/null | grep -i '^location:' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}'); echo "loc=$LOC"; curl -s -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" "http://localhost:3000$LOC" -o /tmp/pf.txt -w "bytes=%{size_download} code=%{http_code}\n"; echo "title: $(grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "fallback: $(grep -c 'Checking availability' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "inventory: $(grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/pf.txt)"

cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; npm run dev >/tmp/dev.log 2>&1 & sleep 9; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /dev/null; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/dev-product.html; sleep 3; echo "=== dev log ==="; cat /tmp/dev.log
cd /workspace; cat /tmp/dev.log 2>/dev/null | tail -40
npm run dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1

sleep 10; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /dev/null; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/dev-product.html; sleep 4; echo "=== title in dev shell: $(grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/dev-product.html) ==="

curl -s http://localhost:3001/ -o /dev/null; curl -s http://localhost:3001/product -o /tmp/dev-product.html; sleep 4; echo "title: $(grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/dev-product.html)"; echo "fallback: $(grep -c 'Checking availability' /tmp/dev-product.html)"
git status --short && echo "=== AGENTS.md ===" && cat AGENTS.md

cp /tmp/page.fixed.tsx app/product/page.tsx && cp /tmp/data.fixed.ts lib/data.ts && sleep 3 && curl -s http://localhost:3001/product -o /dev/null && sleep 4 && echo "=== dev log tail ===" && tail -6 /tmp/dev.log
cat .gitignore; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== diff ==="; git diff -- app lib
(pkill -f "next-server" || true) >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 1; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
ps -eo pid,args | grep -E "next (dev|start)|next-server" | grep -v grep || echo "no stray next servers"
